subject: hydra
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: five-headed hydra.
Style: God of War.

spec.name: Ashen Hydra of the Nine Realms
spec.description: A five-headed hydra coiled on the ground in the God of War style: ash-green serpent scales, a bone dorsal crest, ember-lit runes and gold-bound heads.
spec.layout: A heavy serpent trunk lies in a shallow S-coil on the floor from z = -3.2 (tail tip, curling left to x = -1.55) to z = +1.6 (chest); the belly rests on y = 0 and the body centre sits at y = 0.8 with a radius of 0.8, rising to a broader shoulder hump (radius 0.9, top near y = 1.7) at z = 0.2 where all five necks root. Two stout clawed forelimbs plant at x = ±1.5, z = 1.45, feet flat on the floor. Five serpentine necks rise from the hump and splay like a fan: the central hero neck is tallest (head at y = 3.5, z = 2.25, facing +Z with jaw open), a mid pair reaches y = 3.0 with heads at x = ±1.8, and an outer pair reaches y = 2.75 with heads at x = ±2.3; all heads face forward (+Z) with slightly splayed, snarling angles. Style on every part: deep pine-green scale hide with pale horn belly, bone-coloured horns, crest and fangs, gold trim rings and brow ornaments in the God of War manner, glowing ember-orange runes and eyes (kit glow), moss accents on upward faces, dark ink mouth interiors. Hides may use scales()/mottle()/countershade paints built only from the palette strings so the patterns stay in-palette; trim, eyes, teeth and runes are separate small parts in their own flat colours.

parts.builds: The coiled serpent body and tail. Build one b.chain('body', catmull) from chest [0,0.8,1.5] back through mid [0,0.85,0.2], rump [0,0.8,-1.3], and the tail curve through [0.25,0.6,-2.2], [-0.35,0.45,-2.85], tip [-1.55,0.26,-1.5]; b.sweep it with a radius profile 0.7 → 0.85 (mid) → 0.8 (rump) → 0.45 → 0.3 → 0.05, centres set so the belly touches y = 0 (a wider, taller shoulder hump near z = 0.2, radius up to 0.9). Hide: scales() of scaleMid/scaleDark with countershade to belly on the underside and a mottle() of moss on upward faces. Dorsal crest: a row of alternating bone plates (b.extrude fins, thickness tapering to a knife edge) and curved bone spikes along sweep.line(0), every third plate capped with a small gold stud; the crest shrinks toward the tail. Belly scutes: b.along over the body with pale belly frustumBox plates ringed in bellyShade, widest under the hump. Ember runes: 6-7 small extruded rune plates stuck on the flanks near the hump in ember colour, each glow()-ed at 1.4 with a tiny emberCore core dot. Tail tip: a paired bone barb. A few ink seam lines and cracked-scale studs near the rump for wear.
parts.attaches: Rides core and the tail chain; its shoulder-hump surface swallows the five neckRoot mounts and the two shoulderSocket mounts so neck and limb roots bury into it.

parts.builds: The two stout forelimbs, mirrored in for s of [1, -1]. For each leg build the chain shoulderL/R → elbowL/R → footL/R and a loft of muscle-bound segments: fat upper arm (frustumBox or sweep, half-extents ~0.34) tapering to a hard forearm, hide in scales() of scaleMid/scaleDark with a pale belly underside. Elbow: a bone spike and a gold bracer ring (surface.loop + sweep, with small goldBright studs along it). Hand: a heavy knuckle block on the foot joint with three splayed toes riding toeL*/toeR* joints, each toe a frustumBox digit ending in a long curved claw (bezier sweep tapering to a point, flat-shaded) in claw colour with a bone base ring; the pads of the feet at y = 0 exactly (contact at pawPadL/pawPadR). One ember rune plate glow()-ed on each shoulder, and a strap of ink leather wrapping the upper arm with a gold buckle.
parts.attaches: Roots bury into the trunk at shoulderSocketL/shoulderSocketR; feet rest on the floor at pawPadL/pawPadR.

parts.builds: The four non-hero necks and heads, mirrored pairs (ML/MR mid, OL/OR outer) built from the listed neck chains: b.sweep each chain with radius ~0.26 tapering to 0.15, hide in scales() of scaleMid/scaleDark with countershade to belly on the throat and darker scaleLight highlights on top; rings of pale throat scutes near the base. Neck mane: b.along along each neck's dorsal line with curved bone spikes leaning back, longer at the base, shorter near the head. Each head rides its head* joint: a lofted or lathe skull (long serpent snout, brow ridge in scaleDark, ink nostrils), a separate lower jaw on the jaw* joint, hinged slightly open with an ink mouth interior, bone fangs (upper two, lower one) and a tongue in tongue colour; a curved bone horn pair sweeps back from the skull with gold rings at the base. Eyes: small ember spheres glow()-ed at 1.6 under a bone brow shelf, with an ink socket rim. A short membrane frill (b.membrane in membrane colour with a bone spar) runs behind the skull of the outer pair only.
parts.attaches: Each neck root buries into the trunk's shoulder hump at neckRootML/neckRootMR/neckRootOL/neckRootOR.

parts.builds: The central hero neck and head, the richest piece. Neck: b.sweep the nC1..nC4 chain with radius 0.3 tapering to 0.17, scales() hide of scaleMid/scaleDark, countershade to belly, moss mottle on top; a full mane of broad overlapping extruded blades along the dorsal line from root to tip, root-to-tip palette scaleDark → bone, plus a gold collar ring with ember studs (glow()-ed) at the base over the hump. Head on headC: a big lofted skull with a heavy brow, cheek plates in scaleLight, ink nostril slits and cracked scale studs; a gold circlet across the brow with a small embossed diamond; two pairs of curved bone horns (long back-swept upper pair, short lower pair) with gold rings. Wide open jaw on jawC showing rows of bone fangs, an ink throat, and a forked tongue in tongue colour reaching forward. Eyes: large ember orbs glow()-ed at 1.8 with emberCore highlights and heavy ink lash/brow shelves so they read from the front. A tall membrane crest (membrane colour, bone spars) rises behind the horns.
parts.attaches: Roots into the trunk's hump top at neckRootC, directly above core.
